messages.subject: For Suvi | Global Energy, Industrial and External Affairs Executive | Expat Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Suvi,

Your leadership of Heidrick & Struggles' global Energy sector, together with your focus on cross-border executive mobility and expatriate leadership in the Middle East, makes this a focused introduction. I am pursuing Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates where government and external affairs, ESG, stakeholder strategy and country-facing execution sit close to business performance.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group in Guyana. My remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate affairs, strategic stakeholder engagement, executive communications and cross-functional coordination in a capital-intensive mining environment. Across 12+ years, I have also worked in regulated financial services and commercial operations.

My target universe includes multinational energy and industrial platforms such as Equinor, Siemens, Eaton, ArcelorMittal and comparable businesses, with strong interest in Saudi Arabia, the UAE and wider international assignments. I am globally mobile and open to expatriate, residential and rotational roles, subject to employer-supported work authorization where required.

My executive CV is attached. I would value consideration for current or upcoming mandates where my combination of institutional leadership, responsible business, energy-transition exposure and emerging-market execution fits the brief.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
